Both cannot be true.

grammar.meaning: reporting a general belief without naming a source

explanation.en: Two patterns report what people say without saying who: 'It is believed that he left' and 'He is believed to have left.'
explanation.uz: Kim aytganini aytmasdan xabar berishning ikki yo'li bor: 'It is believed that he left' va 'He is believed to have left.'

grammar.positive_example: The building is said to be over 500 years old.
grammar.negative_example: The building is said that it is over 500 years old.

l1_notes.uz: Ikki naqsh aralashtiriladi; 'that' bilan boshlangan gapda ega 'it' bo'lishi shart.

grammar.label: have something done — causative
grammar.meaning: arranging for somebody else to do the work

explanation.en: 'I had my car repaired' means somebody else repaired it for me. Compare 'I repaired my car', where I did the work.
explanation.uz: 'I had my car repaired' — mashinani boshqa kishi tuzatdi. 'I repaired my car' esa o'zim tuzatganim.

grammar.positive_example: We are having the kitchen painted next week.
grammar.negative_example: We are having painted the kitchen next week.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekcha orttirma nisbat (-tir-) bir qo'shimcha bilan beriladi; ingliz tilida so'z tartibi hal qiladi.
